online_update_design.status: PUBLISHED in 0.7.0; retained by 0.8.0 with dual-baseline native upgrade regression pending
online_update_design.source: Fixed whoarei/tts-lab GitHub Release HTTPS metadata and matching Windows package/SHA256 assets
online_update_design.automatic_checks: Enabled by default at startup at most once daily; user can disable independently of manual checking; never automatically downloads or installs
online_update_design.download: User-triggered download with bounded length, progress and SHA256 verification before install is offered
online_update_design.apply: Drains earlier mutating API requests, checks actual unfinished tasks and active model installs through a lightweight local activity gate without job/history content, and freezes new writes while closing Python. Busy state preserves the verified download. A separate helper applies NSIS or manifest-validated portable updates while preserving unknown files and the user profile.
online_update_design.helper_staging: Requests, ready acknowledgment and result files confined to a unique real %LOCALAPPDATA%\TTS Lab\updates staging directory; package/helper outside target application folder
online_update_design.trust: Unsigned release channel: HTTPS and SHA256 do not provide a publisher signature independent of the GitHub repository/release account; no updater-plugin signature verification claimed
online_update_design.bootstrap: Published v0.6.0 needs one manual installation of v0.7.0; later desktop versions can use online updates
